units.source_text: 左大臣走出来说：“夜色已很深了！”

en.t: The Minister of the Left came out and said, "The night is already very late!"

units.source_text: 便派侍女去请新郎赴席。

en.t: He then sent a maid to invite the bridegroom to the banquet.

units.source_text: 匂亲王正和六女公子游戏取乐，并不立刻出来。

en.t: Prince Niou was amusing himself with the Sixth Lady and did not come out at once.

units.source_text: 云居雁夫人的兄弟左卫门督及藤宰相先出来了。

en.t: Lady Kumoi no Kari's brothers, the Captain of the Left Gate Guards and Counselor To, came out first.

units.source_text: 过了一会，新郎好容易来到，容姿优美无比。

en.t: After a while, the bridegroom finally arrived, and his appearance was incomparably graceful.

units.source_text: 主人头中将向匂亲王敬酒，劝请用菜。

en.t: The host, the Captain Secretary, offered wine to Prince Niou and urged him to take some food.
He then continued to offer the cup two or three more times.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言劝酒十分殷勤，匂亲王对他微笑。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, pressed the wine on him with great courtesy, and Prince Niou smiled at him.

units.source_text: 大约是因为他以前曾对薰中纳言说过“左大臣家里严肃刻板”，认为这件亲事不甚相称，现在回想起来，所以对他微笑吧。

en.t: Perhaps he smiled because he now remembered having once told Kaoru that the Minister of the Left's household was stiff and solemn, and that this marriage did not seem very well matched.

units.source_text: 但薰中纳言似乎不曾注意及此，只管一本正经地照料。

en.t: But Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, seemed not to notice this and simply went on attending to matters with perfect seriousness.

units.source_text: 他走到东厅去犒赏匂亲王的随从人员。

en.t: He went to the eastern hall to reward Prince Niou's attendants.

units.source_text: 其中身份高贵的殿上人甚多：四位者六人，每人犒赏女装一套，又加长褂一件；五位者十人，每人犒赏三重唐装一套，其裙腰装饰各人不同；六位者四人，每人犒赏绫绸长褂及裙等。

en.t: Among them were many high-ranking courtiers: six men of the fourth rank each received a set of women's robes and an additional long outer robe; ten men of the fifth rank each received a set of three-layer Chinese-style robes, with different decorations on each skirt band; and four men of the sixth rank each received figured silk long robes, skirts, and the like.

units.source_text: 犒赏品依照规定数量，似乎还嫌菲薄，因此在配色及质料上特别加工，务求尽善尽美。

en.t: Because the prescribed number of gifts still seemed rather meager, special care was taken with their color combinations and materials, striving to make them as fine as possible.

units.source_text: 对于近侍及舍人，犒赏尤为优厚，甚至打破常规。

en.t: For the close attendants and retainers, the rewards were especially generous, even going beyond the usual rules.

units.source_text: 此等繁华热闹之事，原是人人所爱读的，古代小说中首先描述此种情状，大约是为此吧？

en.t: Such splendid and lively scenes are, after all, what everyone enjoys reading, and perhaps that is why old tales first described such occasions.

units.source_text: 这里所列举的，恐怕太不详细呢。

en.t: What has been listed here is probably far too lacking in detail.
